summary: This is a YAML configuration block for a Reveal.js presentation (a tool for making slideshows). It's telling the presentation engine to load a custom JavaScript file from the assets folder so you can add extra functionality or styling to your slides.

explanations.3: revealjs is the format we're configuring — it's a popular HTML-based slideshow framework
explanations.4: header-includes means we're adding content that goes into the HTML document's header section
explanations.5: This script tag tells the browser to load and run our custom.js file, which contains JavaScript code that modifies or enhances the presentation
